en.name: Brazil Agro-Export Mission to China
en.description: MAPA-endorsed export mission connecting Brazilian soy, cotton, and protein exporters with Chinese food processors.
en.metaTitle: Brazil Agro-Export Mission to China | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: MAPA-endorsed export mission connecting Brazilian soy, cotton, and protein exporters with Chinese food processors. Brasília + Shanghai, 26–27 March 2026.
en.overviewHtml: A MAPA-endorsed export mission connecting Brazilian soy, cotton, and protein exporters directly with Chinese food processors.
en.whoShouldAttendHtml: Agricultural exporters, trade associations, and Chinese food-processing procurement teams.
en.formatHtml: A two-city mission with delegation briefings in Brasilia and buyer meetings in Shanghai.

br.name: Missao Brasileira de Agro-Exportacao para a China
br.description: Missao de exportacao endossada pelo MAPA, conectando exportadores brasileiros de soja, algodao e proteina animal a processadoras de alimentos chinesas.
br.metaTitle: Missao Brasileira de Agro-Exportacao para a China | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Missao de exportacao endossada pelo MAPA, conectando exportadores brasileiros de soja, algodao e proteina animal a processadoras de alimentos chinesas. Em Brasilia + Shanghai, 26–27 de marco de 2026.
br.overviewHtml: Uma missao de exportacao endossada pelo MAPA, conectando diretamente exportadores brasileiros de soja, algodao e proteina animal a processadoras de alimentos chinesas.
br.whoShouldAttendHtml: Exportadores agricolas, associacoes comerciais e equipes de compras de processadoras de alimentos chinesas.
br.formatHtml: Uma missao em duas cidades, com briefings da delegacao em Brasilia e reunioes com compradores em Shanghai.

cn.name: 巴西对华农产品出口使团
cn.description: 获巴西农业部（MAPA）背书的出口使团，联接巴西大豆、棉花及蛋白质出口商与中国食品加工企业。
cn.metaTitle: 巴西对华农产品出口使团 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 2026年3月26–27日，巴西利亚与上海，获巴西农业部（MAPA）背书的出口使团，联接巴西大豆、棉花及蛋白质出口商与中国食品加工企业。
cn.overviewHtml: 获巴西农业部（MAPA）背书的出口使团，直接将巴西大豆、棉花及蛋白质出口商与中国食品加工企业相连。
cn.whoShouldAttendHtml: 农产品出口商、行业协会，以及中国食品加工企业采购团队。
cn.formatHtml: 为期两地的使团行程，在巴西利亚进行代表团简报，并在上海安排买家会面。
